test_title: PYST 49: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All flowers are trees.

All leaves are flowers.

**Conclusion:**

I) All trees are flowers.

II) All leaves are trees.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.
Both Conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4088b3f6e0ffee517c151c49130617365d5c3b1f848501ec587ba9aeace4e1b1.png] 

Conclusion:

I) All trees are flowers → **Not Follows** (Because some trees are flowers).

II) All leaves are trees → **Follows **(Because all leaves are flowers, and all flowers are trees).

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only Conclusion II follows"**.
